material_findings.title: 2026 Epic AI MegaJam
material_findings.confidence: high for official organizer announcement and prize schedule; medium for complete eligibility/entry cost
material_findings.prize_evidence: Organizer lists $65,000 in category cash awards: three $15,000 main prize ladders (Unreal Engine, UEFN, student-only), plus $20,000 in modifier awards. Development Continuation Grants up to $50,000 per team are separate conditional grants, not cash awards available to every entrant. Solo Driver modifier $2,500; overall Unreal Engine and UEFN top awards $7,500 each.
material_findings.eligibility: Organizer overview says developers 18+ with active Epic Games account, solo or up to five humans, online from anywhere subject to full official rules; complete geography/affiliation exclusions not verified because official Box rules inaccessible.
material_findings.entry_cost: Not independently verified from complete official rules; online participation advertised, Unreal Engine/UEFN setup and optional AI/cloud costs not verified.
material_findings.authorization: Competition authorizes building and submitting an original game only; no security testing of public services, game servers or third-party assets authorized.
material_findings.requirements: Choose Unreal Engine or UEFN; work begins no earlier than Nov 12; packaged playable game or immutable UEFN private version code; 30-60 second gameplay video; team member Epic account email; licensed assets with disclosure; optional dev log required for Glass Box modifier.
